blocks.html: As Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) marks its 45th anniversary, its office development and leasing arm, Robinsons Offices, has emerged as the top-performing developer in the Philippine office leasing market for the second quarter of 2025, according to CBRE Philippines’ latest market report.

The performance reflects Robinsons Offices’ commitment to its core mission: to drive job creation, decentralize economic opportunities, and develop sustainable, future-ready workspaces across the Philippines.

In the 2Q of 2025, Robinsons Offices closed close to 50,000 square meters of new office transactions – the highest among all developers nationwide. The company also secured the largest share of IT-BPM transactions, reaffirming its role in supporting the country’s leading job-generating sector.

Its latest development, GBF Center 2 in Bridgetowne emerged as the top-performing office tower in the country during this period, contributing 27,100 square meters of new transactions. Designed with energy-efficient systems and smart building features, GBF Center 2 exemplifies the company’s four pillars: premium, accessible, future-ready, and sustainable.

“We are proud to lead the market – not just in square meters, but in purpose,” says Ms. Mybelle Aragon GoBio, President and CEO of RLC. Ms. GoBio adds that this milestone reflects the Company’s commitment to building more than just office towers-its building communities that altogether help build better lives.

“Our strong second quarter shows the trust of the IT-BPM sector and other growth industries in Robinsons Offices,” added Mr. Jericho P. Go, Senior Vice President and General Manager of Robinsons Offices. “We are committed to expand our footprint, especially in emerging business hubs, providing companies here and abroad with premium-grade workspaces that generates jobs, keep families together, and bestow upon the next generation a better and brighter tomorrow.”

As the country continues to evolve, Robinsons Offices stays at the forefront – delivering future-ready spaces that support the ambitions of both local and global enterprises, while advancing a shared vision of sustainable and inclusive progress.
